description: Defines the CookieDeletionInfo structure and its nested TimeRange class, used for specifying cookie deletion parameters including time ranges, matching criteria, and session control.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo
classes.description: Structure used to specify which cookies to delete, including matching criteria and deletion options.

classes.name: TimeRange
classes.description: Represents a range of time for cookie deletion, with inclusive start and exclusive end times, and special handling for a start==end case.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given time falls within the TimeRange.

methods.name: SetStart
methods.description: Sets the start time of the TimeRange.

methods.name: SetEnd
methods.description: Sets the end time of the TimeRange.
